candidate_lesson.lesson_text: When the 30-indicator consensus shows high conviction (conv >= 100%) but green_matches <= 1, the signal is a statistical orphan — trust the historical hit rate, not the live conviction number.
candidate_lesson.mechanism: Conviction measures live indicator agreement (breadth of bullish votes), while green_matches counts how many times a near-identical live configuration produced a win historically. A 100% conviction with 1 green_match means the system has never actually seen this exact regime pay off — the confidence is spatial (indicators agreeing right now) not temporal (this pattern working before). Institutional flow can produce broad indicator agreement at exhaustion points, so unanchored conviction is where crowded late-trend entries cluster.
candidate_lesson.testable_rule: if consensus_conviction >= 1.0 and green_matches <= 1: size *= 0.5  # require temporal confirmation, not just live breadth
candidate_lesson.expected_impact: Win rate +2-4% and Sharpe +0.02-0.04 by de-weighting EURUSD-type signals (conv=100%, green_matches=1) that lack historical analog support.
candidate_lesson.evidence_from_harvest: EURUSD shows conv=100% but green_matches=1 and USDJPY shows conv=100% with green_matches=0 — both maximally 'confident' yet nearly unanchored historically, while GBPUSD (conv=83%, green_matches=4, hist_hr=68%) and AUDUSD (conv=75%, green_matches=3, hist_hr=68%) have lower conviction but more historical analogs.
